headline: Purification, from entry to detail
overview: Purification guides you through spiritual cleansing and renewal practices drawn from contemplative traditions. The practices help you intentionally release what no longer serves you — negative patterns, grudges, emotional residue — and create space for clarity, intention, and renewal. Each session is a structured ritual that combines reflection, intention-setting, and symbolic release.
targetAudience: Users interested in spirituality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Purification — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with available purification practices and guidance on the process.

keyFeatures: Structured spiritual cleansing practices rooted in contemplative traditions
Guided ritual experience combining reflection, intention, and release
Track your purification practice history over time
Intention-setting exercises to define what you're creating space for
tips: Approach purification practices with openness — the symbolic dimension matters even if it feels unfamiliar
Use this tool after completing a major life chapter or before starting a new one
